Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Card
Direct Known Subclasses:
BuildingCard, TribeCard
public abstract class Card extends Object
Abstract base class for all cards in the game.

Each card has a unique ID, belongs to a specific Age, and tracks whether it has already been drawn from the deck.
